entries.title: SPRAWL

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: SPRAWL launched first on Windows PC and later came to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; the PC version remains the best fidelity/capture/input route with no sourced console-exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SPRAWL on Steam or Epic Games Store for Windows PC. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only if a console route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: SPRAWL Zero has been announced for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S, but it has no sourced release date or playable release to archive as a separate entry yet.
